threat_event: Intruder uses the integrator's always-on remote-support tool at a county site to reach the BAS and access control systems, unlocks doors after hours, and changes HVAC setpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote-support tool with no MFA, no session approval, and no logging; flat county service center networks
regulatory_driver: CT-C security addendum; C-GOVERNMENT-R06 (proposed, tracked only)
existing_controls: Edge firewall at each site; MFA on administrator portals
treatment_plan: Remove the remote-support tool; route all integrator and technician access through the jump host (SYS-03) with MFA, per-session approval, and recording; segment county service centers

threat_event: Attacker with a technician's stolen VPN session uses the shared roc-tech account to change BAS programs at the state complex
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared supervisory account; no attribution of changes; jump host bypassed
regulatory_driver: CT-S cybersecurity exhibit (SP 800-53 Moderate: IA-2; AC-2)
treatment_plan: Named accounts on the supervisory server tied to the identity provider; retire the shared account; enforce jump host path

threat_event: Attacker or insider on the county network logs in to BACnet controllers or an NVR with manufacturer default passwords and alters programs or video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 9 controllers and 1 NVR (found in P07 testing); controllers reachable from the county network
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 and SYS-02 field devices at county service centers
treatment_plan: Change all default credentials; add a default-credential check to commissioning and quarterly OT checks

threat_event: Malware on a county office PC spreads to BAS and door controllers at the service centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAS and door controllers share the county general building network; edge firewall allows any traffic from the county network
regulatory_driver: CT-C security addendum; county standards under Fla. Stat. 282.3185(4)
existing_controls: Edge firewall at each site, permissive
treatment_plan: OT VLANs at the 4 service centers with deny-by-default rules; coordinate change with county IT

threat_event: Cardholder records (about 5,000 people, badge photos, 140 face templates) exported through an active account of a departed technician
threat_source: Former workforce member or credential thief
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 departed technicians still active in the administrator portal; accounts disabled about 3 business days after departure
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6); CT-S exhibit; CT-C addendum
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR ticket; monthly administrator account review in the platform; remove the 3 accounts now

threat_event: Ransomware in the cloud tenant encrypts the BAS supervisory server and deletes its backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in the same account and region as production; not immutable; never restore-tested
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore tests; break-glass access

threat_event: A failed or tampered controller cannot be restored because program backups exist only on technicians' laptops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No central, versioned repository of controller programs and graphics
existing_controls: Some programs on laptops; the vendor holds original commissioning files for 2 sites
treatment_plan: Central versioned program repository in the cloud tenant; nightly pull from the supervisory server; hash check before restore

threat_event: Extended BAS supervisory outage at the state or county sites during summer with no manual operating procedures, forcing building closure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No building recovery (manual-mode) procedures for CT-S and CT-C (the federal site has them)
existing_controls: Controllers keep their last schedules; the federal site's procedures can serve as a model
treatment_plan: Write and exercise manual-mode procedures for each state and county building, using the BTTRG building recovery approach

threat_event: Covered video surveillance equipment is in use by the company, breaching the FAR 52.204-25 representation and putting the federal contract at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HQ NVR and 4 cameras from a 2019 reseller purchase with unconfirmed manufacturer; no supplier screening
treatment_plan: Confirm the manufacturer by 2026-09-30; report within 1 business day if covered; replace the HQ video system regardless by 2026-10-31; add supplier screening to purchasing

threat_event: GSA CUI building drawings disclosed through unencrypted email to subcontractors or the general file share
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI stored with general files; no marking, encryption, or access limits; no CUI training
regulatory_driver: 32 CFR 2002; GSA Order PBS 3490.3; CT-F statement of work
existing_controls: Identity provider MFA on the file share
treatment_plan: Restricted CUI library with named access; encrypted transfer to subcontractors with signed handling terms; CUI training

threat_event: Customer notice deadlines are missed after an incident, so the county misses its own 48-hour or 12-hour state reporting clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IR plan; 24-hour and immediate customer notice terms not mapped to a procedure
regulatory_driver: CT-C (24 h); CT-S (24 h); CT-F (BTTRG 1.6.1 immediate report); Fla. Stat. 282.3185(5)
treatment_plan: IR policy and runbook with a notification matrix (P06, P08); tabletop with each customer

threat_event: A departed employee keeps a GSA PIV card and uses it to enter the federal building
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist item for PIV return; 1 card not returned (P07)
existing_controls: GSA can revoke cards when told
treatment_plan: Termination checklist collects the PIV card on the last day and notifies the GSA sponsor the same day

threat_event: Face verification pilot fails some groups more often or exposes face templates (biometric data)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without assessment; no bias testing, retention rule, or consent record
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)1.a.(VI); Fla. Stat. 119.071; C-GOVERNMENT-R08 (vendor platform)
treatment_plan: Complete P10 conditions: bias testing plan, written consent, 30-day template deletion after opt-out, badge-plus-PIN alternative

threat_event: The county expands face recognition to 1:N identification of the public in lobbies without governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No company position on use cases it will operate
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
treatment_plan: Company declines to configure or operate 1:N identification (P10 AI-002) unless re-assessed; letter to the county

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported OS on the two county engineering workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OS past vendor support; required by a legacy BAS tool
existing_controls: Behind the edge firewall; EDR agent unsupported
treatment_plan: Isolate on the OT VLAN with no internet; replace the legacy tool at the next BAS upgrade

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in the out-of-date edge firewall and VPN firmware to enter a site OT network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware 3 releases behind; no vulnerability scanning; VPN service exposed
existing_controls: No management interface on the internet
treatment_plan: Update firmware now; monthly firmware review; external and internal vulnerability scans

threat_event: An intrusion goes undetected for weeks because no one collects or reviews OT and remote access logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No central logging; default retention; no review
treatment_plan: Central log workspace (1-year retention) for jump host, administrator portals, supervisory server, and edge firewalls; weekly review; alert rules

threat_event: Business email compromise of a Site Manager mailbox is used to redirect a customer payment or request site access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; no out-of-band verification rule
treatment_plan: Phishing training and quarterly exercises; callback verification for payment and access changes

threat_event: Compromise of the integrator's own network exposes stored site credentials for CT-S and CT-C
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security terms, flow-downs, or review of the integrator
treatment_plan: Security addendum for subcontractors (MFA, notice within 24 hours, flow-downs); annual review; integrator access only through the jump host

threat_event: Access control SaaS outage longer than the controllers' 72-hour cache
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cloud service; controllers cache credentials for up to 72 hours
treatment_plan: Confirm vendor RTO in the SOC 2 review (P09); local emergency badge list procedure

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for both administrators; conditional access
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: A hurricane closes the HQ and ROC for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented alternate ROC arrangement
existing_controls: ROC workstation software runs on laptops; cloud-hosted platform
treatment_plan: Document remote ROC operation from laptops and an alternate work site; test before hurricane season

threat_event: A disgruntled technician deletes controller programs or changes door schedules using shared credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts hide who made changes; no change review
treatment_plan: Named accounts (R-002); change log review by the Controls Engineering Manager; sanctions policy

threat_event: A lost technician laptop exposes cached drawings and controller program files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program files and some drawings cached locally
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all laptops; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Move program files to the central repository (R-007); block CUI sync to laptops

threat_event: GSA finds the company's CMMS, email, and file storage do not meet the 15 FAR 52.204-21 requirements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented mapping of 52.204-21 controls; no vulnerability scanning; visitor logs incomplete at HQ
treatment_plan: Close the 52.204-21 gaps in P03; keep the P03 mapping as evidence

threat_event: The company releases exempt security system information in response to a public records request, or fails to produce public records the county requests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No procedure for Fla. Stat. 119.0701 requests; staff unaware that security system plans are exempt
existing_controls: Contract clause names the county records custodian
treatment_plan: Route all records requests to the customer's custodian; train Site Managers

threat_event: Unauthorized person enters the ROC and uses an unlocked workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ROC in a shared office building
existing_controls: Badge-controlled suite; screen lock after 10 minutes
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Very Low

threat_event: Breach at the CMMS vendor exposes FCI and site asset data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS; no contractual breach notice term
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report on file
treatment_plan: Add 72-hour breach notice at renewal; rely on vendor SOC 2 and cyber insurance

threat_event: A new FASCSA order covers equipment the company uses and is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No quarterly SAM.gov check
treatment_plan: Quarterly SAM.gov FASCSA check logged by the Contracts Manager

threat_event: Denial-of-service against a site VPN interrupts remote monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet circuit per site
existing_controls: Controllers operate locally; on-site staff during business hours
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: A critical after-hours alarm (freeze, server room temperature) is missed because the ROC is not staffed 24x7
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ROC staffed 06:00-22:00 weekdays; after-hours alarms go to one on-call phone
treatment_plan: Alarm escalation to a second on-call and the Site Manager after 15 minutes

threat_event: Unknown devices on the county BAS network are rogue or compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 BACnet devices at the county government center not in the asset list (P07)
treatment_plan: Identify all 23 devices with the county and the integrator; reconciled OT inventory quarterly

threat_event: Social engineering call posing as the BAS vendor persuades a ROC operator to grant remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No role-based OT training; no call-back rule for vendor access
treatment_plan: Role-based OT training; vendor access only by ticket with call-back to a known number
